levels.label: Kindergarten
levels.notation: None. Words and pictures only. Numerals 0–10.
levels.voice: Second person, present tense, 6–12 word sentences. Every module ends with one thing to do.

levels.label: 2nd grade
levels.notation: = + − > <, numerals to 1000. No ×, no ÷, no fractions as numbers, no negatives.
levels.voice: Warmth, two-step chains, 8–12 word sentences. Counting and repeated adding only. Even/odd by pairing is on-grade and does the work multiplication would.

levels.label: 5th grade
levels.notation: Adds × ÷ fractions decimals, { } ∈ ∉ ⊆ ∪ ∩, set names as labels. No letters standing for numbers, no negatives.
levels.voice: The turn to why. Discussion/Proof shape introduced. The arbitrary-element move is done in words — take any one and follow it — because variables are grade 6.

levels.label: 8th grade
levels.notation: Adds letters as numbers, negatives, exponents, √, ¬ ∧ ∨ ⇒ ≠ ∅, set-builder, ℕ ℤ ℚ ℝ. Not f(x) — that is high school.
levels.voice: Pre-algebra fluency assumed. Proofs are real proofs, 3–8 sentences. The reader already knows √2 is irrational and already has the definition of a function — both are payoffs, not new ideas.

levels.label: 9th grade
levels.notation: Adds ∀, ∃, ⇔, | (divides), interval notation, f(x), f: S → T.
levels.voice: Algebra I complete. Quantifiers introduced. Examples move to inequalities, systems, quadratics, sequences.

levels.label: 10th grade
levels.notation: Adds ≡, ∃!, f⁻¹, ∘, ℕ ℤ ℚ ℝ ℂ.
levels.voice: The proof year. Explicitly connects to the two-column proofs the reader is being taught right now, and uses their own theorems — vertical angles, base angles, ASA/SAS/SSS — as examples.

levels.label: 12th grade
levels.notation: Full Math 0 notation: adds Σ, ∏, factorials, e^{iθ}.
levels.voice: Precalculus reader. Examples come from precalculus — De Moivre, telescoping sums, the exponential series — not from later subjects. Where this goes points at calculus and linear algebra.

levels.label: College
levels.notation: Full Math 0 notation, plus forward references.
levels.voice: Math 0 as intended. WhereThisGoes closer on every module, naming the field it opens.
